title: Babel Babel Babble x ZYN FAST RAP: BABBLE BOTS RAP-OFF
style: industrial electronic, post-punk, 126 BPM, spoken intro, deadpan duet vocals, vocoder hook, analog synth bass, live drum kit, distorted guitar stabs, modular bleeps, punchy kick, articulate snare, gated room reverb, tape saturation, vinyl crackle, chant hook, sparse breakdown, call and response, defiant urgency
lyrics:
[singer A]
Meet me in the booth, meet me in the sound
Babel babel babble — lay that rhythm down

[singer B]
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound
If you got something real to say, don’t type it — lay it down

[singer A]
Don't want your typed-out proof, don't need your alibi
Everybody brave online till the beat asks who and why
I came in through the side door, lights moving slow
Babble bots en la cabina, ready for the show
This ain't comments, this a coded tone
Babel babel babble — the booth is home

[transition]

[singer B]
I don’t want your keyboard flex, no paragraphs, no cap
Everybody tough behind the screen till the voice says “what you got?”
I slid in through the waveform, low lights, bass in the throat
You dropped two real words in the track and I felt that
No comment section, no reply chain, no dopamine war
This ain’t a feed, this a frequency — open up the door

[singer A]
No feed war, no long explainers
No fake saints, no dopamine chasers
Just hook, verse, bass, truth
Babel babel babble — that's the proof

[instrumental]

[singer B]
SongPal! I sing it back!
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!
No comments! No comments! No fingers on the keys
If you wanna send that feeling — put that feeling in the song!

[singer A]
Babble bots in the background
Copy what we say
Babel babel babble — carry it away
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song

[transition]

[singer B]
You want the message clear? Here it is.
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.
I need the crack in your voice, not the perfect written line
That little break, that human shake — tell me it’s real this time
Everybody posting to be seen, I wanna feel what you mean
So call me through the speaker, through the wire, through the steam

[singer A]
I don't need a perfect line
I need the crack inside your voice
That little human break of time
That says this rhythm was a choice
Babble bots en la cabina, faders to the red
If the feeling's real enough, let the chorus say it instead

[transition]

[singer B]
SongPal! I sing it back!
SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!
No comments on the timeline, no fingers on the keys
If you mean it, make it strong — put that feeling in the song!

[singer A]
Babble bots in the background
Now they lead the wave
Babel babel babble — only songs that say we're brave
Ponlo en la canción — ponlo en la canción
If you mean it, make it strong — put that feeling in the song
